# The grid cell-editing fixture pushes both grids 31 px off-screen

## Context

Reported by @tobiu from the fixture page itself (`test/playwright/component/apps/grid-cell-editing/index.html`): an "info text" sits clipped at the left edge of the grids. Measured at 1400×900 on `dev@ab2e7cd17c`, the defect is larger than the label.

## The Problem

The fixture's `<button id="grid-cell-editing-outside">Outside the grids</button>` — the focus target outside the app that the reprojection and click-away arms click — is a sibling of the Neo `Viewport` in `<body>`. The theme makes the body a centered flex row (`display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center`), and the Viewport is 100% wide. So the row holds 62 px + 1400 px in a 1400 px window, and centering splits the overflow:

| element | measured |
|---|---|
| button | x = **−31**, 62 px wide: half off-screen, its label wrapped and clipped |
| Viewport and both grids | x = **31**, 1400 px wide: the rightmost 31 px of both grids — the locked-end `Note` and `c39` columns — are off-screen |

Every arm on this fixture has run with the locked-end body partly outside the window.

## The Fix

Give the focus target its own strip above the app in `index.html`: the body stacks as a column, the button keeps its natural size at the top left, and the Viewport fills the rest at full width. Prototyped via an injected style on the same head: the button renders at x = 4 in full, and both grids span x = 0 to 1400. The pooled grid renders 18 rows instead of 19 in the remaining 871 px.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] At 1400×900, the button renders in full inside the window, and both grids start at x = 0 and end at the window's right edge.
- [ ] The button stays outside the Neo app (a plain element), so its role as the non-Neo focus target is unchanged.
- [ ] Every spec on this fixture passes: component `grid`, e2e `grid/CellEditing*`. The 19 → 18 row change is checked against any arm that counts rows.

## Out of Scope

- The fixture's grids and data (`app.mjs`).
- Any other test app's layout.
